name: The Hollow King's Maze
override: John, 2026-10-28: Halloween corn maze. Only the Watabou layout is used; its title, story and notes are set aside.
wall_text: The dense rows of tall dry cornstalks around the floor are the maze walls, seen from directly above, and the darker corn beyond them is the field: keep them exactly as they are; do not move, redraw, trim or extend any corn.
prompt_style: Objects are modeled 3D assets from a modern dark-fantasy video game (Unreal Engine 5), seen from directly above, each casting a soft dark contact shadow onto the floor. A cursed harvest festival in a corn maze at night: carved jack-o'-lanterns, gourds and pumpkins, straw bales, scattered straw, black crows, broken wooden festival props, burlap, rope, candles, cobwebs, dead leaves. Use many small objects (a dozen or more) rather than a few large ones; nothing larger than the sizes given.

1.name: Festival Gate
1.art: a small clearing just inside the maze entrance: a little wooden ticket booth, a fallen hand-painted festival sign (no lettering), a few small carved jack-o'-lanterns lit with candles, scattered straw and tickets, a dropped child's lantern.

2.name: Crow Field
2.art: a large clearing: three dead festival-goers in cloaks lying in the straw, a toppled food cart spilling apples and corn cobs, a broken scarecrow pole, many black crow feathers, several small dead crows, trampled straw.

3.name: Scarecrow Row
3.art: a large clearing: eight scarecrows on wooden poles in two loose rows (each scarecrow small, about one person across), burlap faces, straw hats, a pile of spare straw, a wheelbarrow, scattered tools.

4.name: Rotten Gourd Patch
4.art: a small clearing: a patch of swollen, rotting grey-green gourds and pumpkins on tangled vines across the middle, black mould, a cracked watering can.

5.name: Hay Bale Fort
5.art: a small clearing: a children's fort of small square straw bales stacked in a ring with one gap, a wooden prize chest inside it, a toy wooden sword, a straw doll, a burlap sack.

6.name: Lantern Clearing
6.art: a clearing: a dozen small carved jack-o'-lanterns set on the ground and on short posts in a ring, a wooden carving table with knives and pumpkin pulp, seeds spilled across the floor.

7.name: The Thresher
7.art: a small clearing: an old rusted wooden threshing machine with a crank and a row of curved blades along one side, piles of cut cornstalks, a bloodstained sack.

8.name: Burned Wagon
8.art: a small clearing: the burned black frame of a hay wagon, a charred body in a breastplate beside it, a small sack of rations, ash and burnt straw, broken wheels.

9.name: Farmer's Grave
9.art: a small clearing: a plain wooden coffin half sunk in a freshly dug grave in the middle, a rapier lying across the coffin lid, a shovel, a mound of dark earth, a small wooden grave marker.

10.name: Witch's Cauldron
10.art: a clearing: a large black iron cauldron over a small fire in the middle with green liquid, a ring of small stones around it, bundles of dried herbs and corn husk dolls hanging from short stakes, a wooden stool, bones, a straw broom.

11.name: Bobbing Barrel
11.art: a small clearing: a large wooden barrel of black water with red apples floating in it in the middle, a few apples on the ground, a small wooden bench, a festival bunting rope lying in the straw.

12.name: Hollow Placard
12.art: a small clearing: a wooden placard on a post with a crude painted face (no lettering), torn festival bunting, a small pile of pumpkins, a broken lantern, straw.

13.name: The Hollow King's Clearing
13.art: a clearing at the heart of the maze: a rough throne of straw bales and twisted cornstalks against the east side, a heap of small carved pumpkins around it, a small pile of gold coins and festival prizes, hoofprints scorched into the ground, scattered bones.

14.name: Scarecrow Shrine
14.art: a clearing: a small wooden shrine with a crude carved scarecrow idol, candles and offerings of apples and corn on a low table, an iron key hanging from a hook on the shrine, a ring of small stones, dried flowers.

15.name: Root Cellar Hatch
15.art: a clearing: a wooden cellar hatch set flat into the ground with a rusted iron ring, a small dug-up hole with an old iron strongbox, a broken spade, sacks of potatoes, scattered straw.
